page.overview:
Who is Oswald's Family?

Oswald's Family in the first Fazbear Frights book's Into the Pit story comprises the relatives of Oswald.

Oswald is the main protagonist of the Into the Pit story.

Oswald's unnamed father is the deuteragonist of the Into the Pit story.

Oswald's unnamed mother is a character from Into the Pit. She works as a nurse in a local hospital. As a result she doesn't get to spend much time with Oswald other than breakfast, which forces his father to always take care of him and make him his food. When she is available she usually cooks them dinner and has family nights with them.
